phase: Prospective continuation explicitly requested after F1
authorization: The user requested continued research until all four metrics improve, using training-side validation only to choose hypotheses, and continued public RogNet/GitHub/dashboard updates. This supersedes the earlier six-hypothesis stopping rule for this new phase; earlier frozen code/results remain unchanged.
input_information: Only four original released 211-Angstrom images per forecast. All new candidates and controls have identical fitting/evaluation rows and original fit-block labels. No wind-speed history as a predictor, recurrence data, EVE or external imagery.
validation: Four training-side folds: for each fold in the bank, fit the other three and evaluate that fold. Per-split image centering, normalization and scalers use fitting folds only. Same original training offsets6..18/evaluation offsets6..19. Fold5 bytes are hash-checked and discarded without parsing or retaining them in the development worker.
hypothesis_boundary: Do not read/import F1 final results, released WindNet forecasts, old full-data bundles, or test-case analyses in development. Hypotheses derive only from training-side outcomes and source/metric definitions. Earlier published test scores are already known to this conversation and cannot be made unseen.
controls: Retrain both the original matched WindNet port and the prior M6 frozen recipe within each training-bank split. Use their original training-selected seed epochs38/27/36. Baseline recipes are retained regardless of new candidates.
adoption: Require a candidate to beat BOTH training-side controls on all four aggregated metrics: mean-fold RMSE <=.99*the lower control RMSE; Fisher r >=the higher control r+.005; mean reduced chi-square <=.995*the lower control chi-square; mean original HSE threat score >=the higher control TS+.02. Undefined scores fail. Record all candidates, metrics and ablations; no single-metric promotion.
final: Only after strict training-side adoption and a stability check, freeze exact source/recipe/data identities, then make one separate matched historical five-fold evaluation. No test feedback may determine model choice or a subsequent hypothesis. Report continued prior exposure and sequential-testing limits; never call this a fresh blind confirmation.
budget: Continue inside the original US$5 cumulative estimated Runpod envelope; prior phase conservative estimate US$0.50672. Track live worker cost and download evidence before deleting only resources created for this phase.
publication: Append public experiment records to the existing RogNet campaign; commit code and results to codex/windnet-matched-loop; update the existing owner-private dashboard.
